descFull: Stop re-teaching your agent. Make your agent's memory work like a brain. Hippo is long-term memory for coding agents. It's a critical layer for your AI harness that connects across your different tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex). Local-first. Measured: about half the repeat mistakes of built-in memory alone, at the same cost.
